# ALT 2027 template

Unmodified files from the user-supplied `alt2027-template.zip` in the repository
root, extracted on September 25, 2026. Retain the upstream notices in the files.
The manuscript loads `alt2027.cls`, `jmlr.cls`, and `jmlrutils.sty` from this
directory through `paper/.latexmkrc`. `alt2027-sample.tex` records the supplied
formatting and submission instructions.

The manuscript uses the anonymous submission option, the default 11-point,
single-column layout, and the sample's Times text font. The class supplies the
theorem environments, bibliography style, and ALT 2027 review heading. Use the
`final` class option only when preparing a camera-ready version.

The supplied sample specifies no page limit, but reviewers may stop after the
first 12 pages, excluding references. Report the draft's length without changing
the template or cutting content to fit.
